quotes.speaker: Nate
quotes.summary_phrase: Nate sets performance goals for his second season
quotes.excerpt: This season I'm trying to average at least five and two rebounds.
quotes.quote: This is season two. Last year this was our rookie year. This season I'm trying to average at least five and two rebounds. Last year we averaged zero, we're trying to average two rebounds.
quotes.social_post: Nate is setting some ambitious goals for his second season, aiming to average five points and two rebounds.

quotes.speaker: Nate
quotes.summary_phrase: Nate reflects on meeting his favorite player Damian Lillard
quotes.excerpt: I finally met Damian Lillard, the goat.
quotes.quote: I finally met Damian Lillard, the goat. You guys are about to see the clip of when I met Dame, but I just want to explain how everything kind of happened. This wasn't planned. A lot of people when I posted this picture, everybody thought that this meet-up was planned.
quotes.social_post: Nate clears the air on his viral photo with Damian Lillard. It was not planned, it just happened.

quotes.speaker: Nate
quotes.summary_phrase: Nate explains his long-term fandom of Damian Lillard
quotes.excerpt: Dame, he's my favorite player since I was like fifth grade.
quotes.quote: For the people that don't know, Dame, he's my favorite player since I was like fifth grade, something like that. I think I've had this since like freshman year of high school. Going to Portland, I had no idea there was even a chance or had a dot meeting Dame would even be possible.
quotes.social_post: Nate reflects on meeting his childhood idol Damian Lillard. He has been a fan since the fifth grade.

quotes.speaker: Nate
quotes.summary_phrase: Nate compares the aura of Shai Gilgeous-Alexander and Damian Lillard
quotes.excerpt: I'm going to have to give it to Dame.
quotes.quote: I know a lot of you guys are going to ask this, who has more aura, Shai or Dame? I'm going to have to give it to Dame. Dame, his aura, it was just different.
quotes.social_post: The debate is settled. Nate says Damian Lillard has more aura than Shai Gilgeous-Alexander. Dame, his aura, it was just different.
